name: Pokémon Ruckus
storyline:
An Elite Four member's Pokémon has been stolen! The Torpedo Gang has always been a nuisance, causing ruckus around the region on their quest to get powerful Pokémon. The theft of Ernest's Pokémon however, is unprecedented. Their goals are... unclear. They've always operated with some vague semblance of secrecy, but it really just seems like they want to overthrow their own Leader for some reason. They're completely unorganized, with little to no functional teamwork between them, and the thieves of Ernest's Pokémon claim to be in the "Victini Chasing Special Unit"...

...Maybe it's best not to get too involved with them. You're on your own quest, after all! The Vibrund Region has 8 gyms to conquer and an annual League Tournament where the Champion is crowned. Just last year, Jaxton's seemingly neverending winstreak was stopped by relative newcomer Valerie. The League seems to be entering a new era, and maybe you could be the next Vibrund Champion?
